en.summary: Poor inhaler technique is a common reason treatment seems ineffective. NHS: ask a pharmacist/nurse/GP to check technique and spacer use. For acute asthma attack follow the separate asthma-attack entry / emergency care. This pack never invents puff counts or steroid doses.
emergencyIf: Asthma attack with severe breathlessness, cannot speak, blue lips — emergency pathway
seeDoctorIf: Need technique check or spacer advice
doNot: Do not invent inhaler doses or oral steroid courses
Do not skip seeking help for a severe attack

fr.summary: Une mauvaise technique d'inhalateur diminue l'efficacité. Faire vérifier en pharmacie/cabinet. Crise d'asthme sévère = urgence. Pas de posologies inventées.
seeDoctorIf: Besoin de vérifier la technique / chambre

he.summary: טכניקת משאף לקויה מפחיתה יעילות. לבדוק אצל רוקח/אחות/רופא. התקף חמור — חירום. אין מינונים מומצאים.

ru.summary: Плохая техника ингалятора снижает эффект. Проверить у фармацевта/медсестры/врача. Тяжёлый приступ — неотложка. Дозы не выдумывать.
